epics.sixSigmaMetric: 100% successful container environment launches without manual intervention
requirements: R1: The backend container must not crash with a 'port is already allocated' conflict for port 18080 during docker compose up

slices.title: Resolve docker compose backend port 18080 conflict
slices.jtbd: When implementing the docker compose fix for this epic, I want the backend port binding to be correctly configured, so that the application container starts successfully
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a local docker environment, When the operator executes docker compose up, Then the backend container starts and binds its port without conflict
Given the backend container is running, When verifying external connectivity, Then the container remains healthy and reachable
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero port collision errors during automated deployment
